subject: Enterprise Azure AI rollout planning
body: Several BFSI customers have requested secure Generative AI capabilities on Microsoft Azure. Azure OpenAI and Azure AI Studio appear suitable for governance and compliance requirements. We should prepare a deployment roadmap before next week's architecture review.

subject: Azure Kubernetes migration proposal
body: Our enterprise clients are evaluating Azure Kubernetes Service for container modernization. Engineering should prepare migration estimates and compare operational costs with current self-managed clusters.

subject: Security assessment for Azure OpenAI deployment
body: Healthcare customers require confirmation regarding HIPAA compliance, data residency and enterprise governance before Azure OpenAI adoption. Please schedule a workshop with Microsoft's technical team.

subject: Proposal for enterprise AI migration to Azure
body: The customer wants to consolidate AI workloads currently spread across multiple cloud providers. Azure AI Studio and Azure Machine Learning provide stronger governance capabilities than their current environment. We should prepare a phased migration plan and expected ROI.

subject: Azure cost optimization before enterprise rollout
body: Finance requested Azure Cost Management recommendations before approving the enterprise AI rollout. Reserved Instances and workload optimization should be included in the proposal.

subject: Azure AI governance discussion
body: Multiple enterprise customers are asking about governance controls for Azure AI. Security and compliance documentation should be finalized before customer demonstrations.

subject: Enterprise Azure OpenAI pilot approval
body: Leadership has approved an Azure OpenAI pilot for document intelligence. Engineering should begin architecture validation and prepare deployment guidelines.

subject: Migration workshop using Azure Landing Zone
body: The customer architecture team wants to adopt Azure Landing Zone as part of their enterprise migration initiative. Please prepare governance templates and security baselines.

subject: Azure AI deployment roadmap
body: Enterprise clients are planning phased Azure AI deployments over the next two quarters. We should align infrastructure modernization with AI governance policies.

subject: Azure Machine Learning integration planning
body: Our analytics team recommends Azure Machine Learning for enterprise predictive analytics workloads. We should estimate infrastructure costs and prepare customer workshops.
